manual_findings.finding: Start loads the retained stack into RSI, process-lifetime tid word0x14610 into RDX, fixed Worker0x1bb0 into RCX, flags0x350900 into EDI and zero context into R8D, then directly calls own trampoline0x1810. No caller callback is accepted.

Trampoline aligns child stack16, reserves16 bytes for entry/context, maps the same tid address into parent_tid RDX and child_tid R10, clears TLS argument, executes clone56. Nonzero parent/error returns on original stack; child calls only the stored fixed entry with null context. Fallback performs raw exit60 then UD2; no libc child trampoline.

The complete Worker body has no call instruction, external/tail edges, FS/GS TLS dereference, errno access, stack-canary helper, atomic runtime or sanitizer helper. Fixed syscalls are close_range, futex, pidfd_open, pidfd_getfd, gettid/getpid, rt_sigprocmask, fstat/fstatfs/fcntl/fgetxattr, close and thread exit60.

Result, global slot and command are written before final request.complete at0x1c46. The following wake accesses only the process-lifetime event0x14604, with no request/context dereference after completion.
Inherited nonnull stack takes the allocation-free branch to startup. sysconf/mmap/mprotect occur only in the null-stack branch in the caller. This is not a claim that the whole library avoids libc.

scope_limits: Worker is not Bionic pthread registered. It must not survive root-to-app, UID/GID/capability/root/mount/policy or zygote/exec/thread-retirement transitions without a qualified lifecycle protocol.
Independent FD table is not credential isolation.
This experiment has fixed owned-tag metadata only; full factory authentication/provenance projection and runtime hooks remain absent.
NOFILE0 remains an expected production-red case; task-count/kernel resource failures remain possible.
No arbitrary callback, full ordinary application workload, or commercial App acceptance is approved by this review.
bounded_runtime_scope: Parent may perform one already prepared exact-hash, nonce-bound, absent-before-install owned r17 application install/run/remove cycle; original Main remains unchanged.
